full_prompt_en: A square fantasy landscape illustration follows a pale winding path through a densely landscaped hillside. The path enters from the lower center, bends around a dark round-canopied tree, and disappears between layered green mounds as it climbs toward a pair of small cream-colored villas with blue roofs on the right. Rounded shrubs and thick domed trees fill almost every part of the slope. Tall, slim cypress-like forms punctuate them in dark teal, while a huge deep green canopy rises near the upper center and overlaps a purple-speckled hill. Toward the left, the land opens to distant pale terraces and blue-green shapes under a bank of luminous clouds. Above, a clear turquoise sky holds peach, pink, cream, and lavender clouds and a faint pale moon at the upper left. No person is visible, so the houses and narrow path give the cultivated landscape its sense of scale. The illustration is built from smooth, carefully bounded shapes with dense stippled and clustered foliage texture inside them. Hills are simplified into broad rounded volumes, yet subtle shading gives each mass a solid, sculptural body. Warm sunlight from the left catches path edges, cloud tops, and facades, while lower foliage falls into cool blue-green and violet shadow. The palette is saturated but controlled: emerald, jade, teal, cobalt, plum, golden sand, and coral-pink light. Overlapping trees establish a rhythmic progression from near dark forms to smaller, brighter forms on the hill. The sharply curved road guides the eye inward without breaking the soft silhouette language. The whole scene feels expansive and idyllic, a richly detailed imagined garden whose geometric order is softened by luxuriant organic surfaces.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻风景插画沿着一条浅色弯路穿过种植密集的山坡。道路从下方中央进入，绕过一棵深色圆冠树，随后在层叠绿丘间消失，向右上方两座蓝屋顶、奶油色小别墅攀升。圆形灌木和厚实圆顶树几乎填满整个坡面。修长的柏树状形体以深青绿色在其中竖起，一棵巨大的深绿树冠升于上方中央，遮住一座带紫色斑点的山丘。左侧土地向远处浅色台地与蓝绿色形块敞开，位于明亮云层下。上方清澈青绿色天空中有桃色、粉色、奶油色与淡紫云朵，左上角还有一轮浅淡的月亮。画中没有人物，房屋与窄路为这片人工栽培的风景提供尺度。插画由平滑、边界仔细的形块建成，内部装满细点和成簇叶片纹理。山丘被简化为宽阔圆润体积，但微妙阴影让各团块拥有结实的雕塑感。来自左侧的暖阳照亮道路边缘、云顶和屋面，低处叶丛则落入冷蓝绿及紫色阴影。色彩饱和而有控制：祖母绿、玉绿、青绿、钴蓝、李紫、金沙色以及珊瑚粉光。相叠树木从近处深色形体到山上较小较亮的形体，形成有节奏的推进。急弯道路引导目光深入，又不破坏柔软剪影语言。整幅场景辽阔而如田园乐土，一座细节丰厚的想象花园，以繁茂有机表面软化几何秩序。
style_prompt_en: A polished fantasy illustration organizes space with overlapping rounded masses, slender vertical accents, and a strong curving line that leads inward. Smooth silhouettes contain fine clustered stipple, giving each colored volume a dense tactile surface. Emerald, jade, teal, cobalt, plum, and warm sand are balanced by coral and cream highlights. Broad gradients and soft directional shading make the simplified forms feel sculptural while keeping their contours crisp. Light enters from one side, gilding upper edges and leaving lower layers in cool violet-blue shadow. The distance opens into paler, flatter bands beneath luminous pastel clouds and a clear saturated upper field. The rhythm is abundant yet carefully ordered, with intimate texture embedded in spacious, dreamlike depth.
style_prompt_zh: 精致奇幻插画以重叠圆润团块、修长竖向重音和一条向内引导的强曲线组织空间。平滑剪影内部充满细密簇状点纹，让每个彩色体积具有浓密可触的表面。祖母绿、玉绿、青绿、钴蓝、李紫和暖沙色由珊瑚色及奶油色亮部平衡。宽缓渐变及柔和定向明暗使简化形体富有雕塑感，同时保持清楚轮廓。光从一侧进入，为上缘镀金，让下层落入冷紫蓝阴影。远方在发亮粉彩云下展开为较浅、较平的色带，面对清澈饱和的上方色域。节奏繁茂却谨慎有序，亲密纹理嵌于开阔如梦的深度中。
theme_en: A winding path climbs a lush hillside of sculpted trees toward small blue-roofed villas
theme_zh: 蜿蜒小路穿过修剪成形的茂密树丛，通向山坡上的蓝顶小别墅
name: Shusei Nagaoka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
